description: Session roles — export the session id as a fallback for CLIs that don't set CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, re-inject the charter and any recorded Notify: target across resume and compaction, remind a pinned planner or epic-coordinator of its charter on every prompt, guard a pinned planner against drifting into implementation (edits and entering a worktree prompt first), stop a pinned implementer from launching issue-spawning sessions, and keep in-process subagents from writing their parent's role marker.
